final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), m AS (SELECT AVG(igm) AS mu FROM j), d AS (SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j.igm, j.igm - m.mu AS dev FROM j, m), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS avgdev FROM d WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation, d.dev - s.avgdev AS excess FROM d JOIN s ON s.SEX = d.SEX WHERE d.dev > s.avgdev ORDER BY excess DESC, d.ID LIMIT 10
